quest.title: The Final Riddle: A Secret Uncovered
quest.description: Thanks to a joint effort, the party finds the key to solving the final riddle. The truth behind these islands is now within reach, but Klee seems to be more anxious than ever. What is the truth that has quietly sat in wait all this time?
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.title: The Final Riddle: A Secret Uncovered

talks.objective: Rest until early morning the next day (06:00 – 08:00)

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight, over here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are the fish?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: As we suspected, they were drawn to the crystal.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Catchy catchy fish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! No, no!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To keep Klee from blowing up the fish to pieces, perhaps it'd be better to let us catch the fish. After all, we're experts at collecting all manner of wildlife!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Klee!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We've finished placing the scales.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yay, amazing! Hehehe, it's my turn now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, we'll leave that mechanism over there to you, Klee!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Klee.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Huh?

choices.text: Please make sure you stay safe.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yep, I got it!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Klee, what's wrong?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I—I'm worried... What if Dodo-King really is in here?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And what if he doesn't allow me to become Dodoco's family, or if I lose to him...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Then Dodoco can't be with me, and Mom will be very sad too... Dodoco is my bestest friend that Mom ever gave me.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I—I'm too scared to press it...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, can you press the button for me?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Klee, I can't help you press it.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Why?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Because I have to hold my weapon.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This way, I can protect you.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Yes, we're all here for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry Klee, we've all got your back!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: No matter who the enemy is, as long as we're here, you don't have to be afraid.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Perfect, I also want to see how strong the enemies on this island really are.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Go.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: I'm here.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Guys, don't say things like that... What if Dodo-King just wants to invite Klee to his house to chat? Or yes, maybe he already approves of Klee!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Will he really approve of me?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Why wouldn't he? You've always tried your best and have done a good job.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Really?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: ...Alright!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Leave this to me!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Press, press... press the button!

choices.text: He will approve of you, I know it.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Huh, this is... Wait, I must be confused. What is this!?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Whoa, this entire island is like a massive gift box hidden beneath the energy shield...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: There seems to be something over there. Shall we take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yes, I wanna look!

dialogues.speaker: Dodo-King
dialogues.text: Wicked girl of flame, you have finally arrived. I've waited far too long — how very boring!

dialogues.speaker: Dodo-King
dialogues.text: You dare face me, the overlord of the Dodo Clan, Dodo-King!? Such glorious courage!

dialogues.speaker: Dodo-King
dialogues.text: Though such courage is admirable, but it is now meaningless because...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Because Dodo-King is me, your mother, Alice!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Huh? Mom!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Alice? The person who wrote the Teyvat Travel Guide!?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Klee and her fellow islanders, hey there!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: So, how did you like it here? Was it fun? Summer skies and the ocean surf, mmm~ Quite the vacation, no?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: There's no use looking for me, I'm not actually near you. The speaking device on the platform before you is none other than my personal creation, the Alice Phonograph! I'm using it to convey a mother's love!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Uh, you can't be serious...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Hey, I didn't scare you all off, did I? Sorry, my Klee loves playing with all sorts of small toys. As her mother, I naturally want to support her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These toys aren't small at all!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Klee's... M—Mother?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: It's a pity that I can't meet you, but I'll be watching your every move from afar, just as always.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It was actually Alice! How careless of me...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Wait, what?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: You might find all of this a bit odd. Why would a mother so far from home expend so much effort to create such an aquatic wonderland?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Ding ding ding! That's correct, I've personally been to those islands. I absolutely adore the ancient ruins and unique landscape. I prepared everything so you all could take part and enjoy the islands as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Klee's mother also seems to have quite the free spirit...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Hehe, are any of you saying bad things about me now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? N—No! Is she listening to us?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: No need to be so troubled.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Klee's mother, Alice, is an extremely enigmatic and near-omnipotent sorceress. Don't be overly concerned. This is just her character.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: You must've been curious about what was behind those letters, the boats, the buoys, the energy shield...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm~ Actually, I thought it was a lot of effort, but this was the only way to invite everyone here, am I right?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: The islands are just full of stories. The original inhabitants, shipwrecks, mystical machinery... Countless coincidences converge here. It would've been such a waste if I didn't make these arrangements.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Now let me guess... Everyone who received a letter should be present. Kaeya, Diluc, Razor, Jean, Barbara...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: #And then there's the reliable and intelligent Albedo, and... the mysterious Traveler and {F#her}{M#his} good companion, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: You all were invited by me to accompany Klee. Thank you all for allowing my daughter to have a memorable summer.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Everything on the islands is a gift for you all, as thanks for keeping my little Klee company. But when you hear this recording, I'll already be traveling in other faraway lands.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: The life of a traveler is such haste and amusement. Haha, ask the traveler next to you and you'll know.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: So Alice went to all these lengths because she was too busy to be with Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: No, Mom's just like that!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Now everyone, if you're trying to find some hidden meaning in all of this, I must tell you that the situation isn't as complicated as you may think.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: The reason why I like the city of Mondstadt is that its freedom is exactly what my daughter and I could ever hope for.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: My wish is simple: I want Klee to grow up with a curious yet kind heart. As long as she so desires, she can do anything and go anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: So that's it. Well, I must admit that it certainly fits Alice's style. My apologies, I misunderstood.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It must be nice to have a mom who's such a character.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep! Mom is the bestest mom!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Mom, we caught fish, sailed a boat, went swimming, and played a lot of things!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Everyone's been super duper amazing and very kind to me!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Next time, you can come with us and we can all play here again!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: It appears that mother and daughter are kindred spirits, both wild and free...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Ah, summer... Speaking of summer, when I went to those islands, it also happened to be summer. Sitting on the beach, listening to the waves roll against my feet, I thought of you.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Klee, you are a child of summer, a present to me from the sea and the wind. Mom is thankful for your birth and wanted to give you something.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: So Mom dressed up these islands, transformed the ancient ruins into a summer park, and used the moniker of Dodo-King to invite you.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: In another world, there are tales of a wondrous island named after golden apples. Known by many names, it embodies the majestic vistas conjured by human fantasy.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Mom loves that story and wanted you to enjoy the wonderful things in it, so Mom gave you sapphire waters, pearly sands, a fantastical paradise...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: For you and for those who love you.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: So there were only three crystals... Light red like flower petals, light blue like ocean waves, light yellow like autumn leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Perhaps from Alice's perspective, this archipelago is the natural fourth crystal. Located in the middle of the sea and covered by plant life, it truly is a lustrous and emerald "Summer Crystal."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Klee, just like Mom, you are of a race blessed with longevity. For us, time is like a gust of wind: moments come and end.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: In such a long life, parents are but a child's first connection. Even though we don't want to be separated, there will come the day when you must walk your own path.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Klee, Mom will always love you, but there are also others by your side.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Friends who accompany you, teachers who educate you, people who are willing to stay on an island for you despite knowing how unusual it is...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Ah, summer is for everyone. No matter how life changes, no matter how many things happen this year, summer will never disappear, just like the love between people.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: From now on, regardless of wherever you go, I hope you never forget how many people in this world love you.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Oh, yes, be sure to listen to Mr. Albedo at home. Mom will regularly return to see you two. Actually, whenever I have a moment to spare, I sneak back to check on you and everyone else. Hee-hee, has no one noticed?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Aunt Alice, the same as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You don't think Albedo knew from the start, do you...?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Huh? Time's almost up, so I'll stop here. Right, right, I spent a lot of effort on this place, so you all must play your hearts out!

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.text: Everyone, my darling Klee, see you next time~

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Bye, Mom!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Klee seems particularly happy.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Dodo-King was actually Mom. I don't know why, but I'm very happy!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter if it's Mom blowing up Mondstadt's main gate, or Mom getting grounded, or Mom writing weird letters. Klee loves her very much.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will you feel lonely without your mother?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Nope. Mom is the most strongest mage, so she can keep me company no matter where she is. She never lets me feel lonely!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I love Mom thiiiiiiiiiis much!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, do you love Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I also love you very much! You have to play with me lots here, or else Mom will be disappointed!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I still have a lot of Jumpy Dumpties and I brought Dodoco here, too. I'll take you swimming and fish blasting!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's always fun when we're with you, Klee!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hey, come on~!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's not keep Klee waiting. C'mon, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, are you going to place the fish scales?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Too bad I can't reach that high...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then I'll be your helping hand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When you say "Now," I'll place it, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: But actually... I don't really understand this part.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: So if you place them for me, it'll be fine! I trust you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then we'll place the fish scales and let Klee activate the final and most important mechanism.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okie dokie!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I'm going to finally see you, Dodo-King! Hee-hee, time to see what you really look like!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I must say, Klee's incredibly excited.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #You can do it, {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight! I'm cheering for you! Yay!

talks.objective: Return to the device and talk to Klee

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The sun's rising. It should be about time to check on the fish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's meet up with everyone first!
